About Olyomu

Olyomu Limited was incorporated on 19 May 2025 and founded by Mrs Ksieng Longrie, an experienced sales and marketing professional. We are building a reputable company that employs and serves Papua New Guineans, adding value to the Government's Vision 2050.

Mission: to create affordable homes and lasting travel experiences, and to promote a healthy lifestyle in Papua New Guinea. Based in Port Moresby, we plan to open offices in other regional centres by 2030.
